newsitem.title: USA: Baxter approves $80 mln plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: Baxter approves $80 mln plant expansion.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said Monday that its directors approved an $80 million expansion of the company's California facility which will allow it to triple production within three years of a blood clotting agent used to treat hemophilia.
The facility where the genetically engineered blood clotting factor, Recombinate rFVIII, is produced is located in Thousand Oaks, Calif.

Demand for Recombinate rFVIII has grown significantly over the last several years while production capacity throughout the industry has been constrained, Baxter officials said after the company's annual shareholders meeting here.
On other action, Baxter said its directors approved payment of a regular quarterly dividend of $0.2825 a share on July 1, 1997, to shareholders of record on June 11, 1997. The
dividend rate is unchanged from the previous quarter.
